dedupe_keys.name: buildingsense a multimodal building function classification dataset

description: The BuildingSense dataset research team publishes a multimodal collection for classifying building function. The repository describes 34,458 buildings with rooftop and surrounding remote-sensing images, street-view imagery, text descriptions and labels from 26 functional categories. Additional attributes include building height, construction year and address. Figshare lists RAR archives, a CSV index, a README and Python preparation and evaluation files. Access is open and free under CC-BY-4.0. The landing description does not establish exact geographic coverage or observation dates, and the linked archives were not inspected. Functional labels and image availability can be uneven, so local checks are needed before transferring a classifier. The collection could train building-use assignment for demand or urban-exposure simulations. It complements the geometry and height in data-globalbuildingatlas with labelled functional examples, not supplying a globally complete function inventory. Address-bearing attributes are part of the published data and were not copied into this catalogue review.
